name: SWE-Compass
abstract: SWE-Compass provides a unified evaluation for agentic coding ability. This page uses the AVG under the Claude Code workflow to avoid mixing different execution environments.
contributions: The paper reports results under both SWE-Agent and Claude Code workflows.
This page fixes one workflow so the leaderboard does not mix model differences with system differences.
method: SWE-Compass aims to unify software engineering evaluation into a framework closer to real developer workflows.
It spans 8 task types, 8 programming scenarios, and 10 programming languages with 2,000 curated instances.
Most instances are derived from authentic GitHub pull requests and refined through systematic validation.
The paper benchmarks strong models under both SWE-Agent and Claude Code frameworks.
Results reveal a clear hierarchy of difficulty across tasks, languages, and programming scenarios.

metrics.name: AVG
metrics.note: Average score under the Claude Code workflow.

leaderboard_note: The primary leaderboard uses AVG under the Claude Code workflow. Mixing SWE-Agent and Claude Code would blur the boundary between model ability and execution environment.
